data.name: Crispin
data.gender_notes: Crispin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word crispus, meaning ‘crisp’ or ‘curly-haired’. The name Crispin was given to children born with crisp or curly hair. It was also used as a nickname for those with a crisp or sharp personality. The name Crispin carries the meaning “Brazen, crisp” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Crispin usually hope their child will grow to embody brazen, crisp and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Crispin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brazen, crisp.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Crispin total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: כריספין
in_hebrew.meaning: שם אדם המסמל חכמה, כושר, ונאמנות
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם כריספין משתייך לקבוצת שמות עבריים שמקורם ביוונית. השם נוצר מהמילה 'chrēstos', שפירושו 'ראוי לעבודה, יפה', ו-'spinos', 'חכם'. חכמה וכושר נחשבו בעברית כאורחות טובות, והשם כריספין הפך זכר לתכונות אלה. במסורת הנוצרית, השם כריספין מסמל נאמנות ואדיקות. בתרבות הנוצרית, שם הבן הפך לסמל לערכי חכמה, כושר, ונאמנות.

in_greek.name: Χριστόφινος
in_greek.meaning: ὁ ἀξιος τοῦ ἔργου, τῆς ὁσιότητος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ ὄνομα Χριστόφινος προέρχεται ἀπὸ τῆς Καινῆς Διαθήκης. Ἡ λέξη Χριστόφινος αποτελείται ἀπὸ τῶν ὀνομάτων Χριστός (ὁ καλός, ὁ ἄξιος) καὶ Φίνος (ὁ ἀξιος τοῦ ἔργου, τῆς ὁσιότητος). Ἡ ἐπώνυμος αὕτη τοῦ ἑνὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἡ Χριστίς, ἀπὸ τῆς ὁποίας ἀπέκτησε τὸ ὄνομα. Ἀπὸ τῆς ἑρμηνείας τοῦ ὀνόματος, ὁ Χριστόφινος ἔχουσι τὴν ἰδιότητα τοῦ ἀξίου τοῦ ἔργου, τῆς ὁσιότητος. Ἡ ἀπάντηση τοῦ Στάχυο, ἀπὸ τῆς ἔννοιας τοῦ Χριστοῦ, σέβεται τὴν ἰδιότητα τοῦ ἀξίου τοῦ ἔργου. Ἡ ἀπάντηση τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἡ ἀλήθεια, ἀπὸ τῆς ἔννοιας τοῦ Στάχυο, σέβεται τὴν ἰδιότητα τοῦ ἀξίου τοῦ ἔργου. Ἡ ἀπάντηση τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἡ ἀλήθεια, ἀπὸ τῆς ἔννοιας τοῦ Στάχυο, σέβεται τὴν ἰδιότητα τοῦ ἀξίου τοῦ ἔργου.

in_latin.name: Crispinus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Crispinus a Christo et Spino derivatur. Cristo significat 'ille qui Christus est', id est 'ille qui est electus' vel 'ille qui est sanctus'. Spino significat 'sapientia' vel 'prudentia'. Nomen Crispinus significat igitur 'ille qui virtutem et fidei habet'. In Ecclesia Catholica, Crispinus nomen est sanctitatis et virtutis. Aeternitas Crispini est in Ecclesia Catholica.

in_english.name: Crispin
in_english.meaning: name meaning 'gift of Christ' or 'wise and faithful'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Crispin is derived from the Latin words 'Christus' and 'spina'. Christus means 'the anointed one', or 'the one chosen by God'. Spina means 'wisdom' or 'prudence'. Therefore, Crispin means 'the gift of Christ' or 'wise and faithful'. In Christian tradition, Crispin is associated with virtues such as wisdom, prudence, and faithfulness. The name Crispin is also associated with Saint Crispin, a 3rd-century martyr who was a Roman soldier and is revered in the Catholic Church.

data.cultural_impact: Crispin as a Christian name holds a rich cultural significance as it reflects the tradition of giving names based on physical features and characteristics. This name adds to the history and diversity of Christian names, showcasing the early practices of naming based on observable traits.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Crispin can be linked to the biblical story of Samson in the Old Testament. Samson was known for his long, curly hair, a symbol of his great strength. As a Christian name, Crispin could be seen as a reminder of the power and strength that comes from one’s spiritual identity, much like the physical strength that can be associated with curly hair. Additionally, the name may serve as an encouragement for individuals to embrace their unique features and characteristics, seeing them as an essential and valued part of who they are.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Crispin translates to "grape-bearer" in Latin, symbolizing the abundance and fruitfulness of the Christian life. Spiritually, it represents the idea of bearing the fruits of the Spirit in one's actions and deeds.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Crispin, a minister in Athens, Greece, shares that their name Crispin meaning "Brazen, crisp" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
